dessin:
A horizontal timeline across the lower middle of the sheet: a thick ink line that starts near the left edge and ends, about three quarters of the way across, on an open solid arrowhead. Short year ticks only on the stretch between the two milestones.
Two milestones on the timeline, drawn as tall vertical ink ticks with a round dot on top: the first one third of the way across, the second a little past the middle.
Top left, at the start of the timeline: a pale document sheet with a plain round seal in it: a double ring with a small plain star inside, no eagle, no animal, no national emblem (a government contract). Next to it: a small pale card with two standing male silhouettes (two men).
Above the timeline, between the two milestones: a pale format sheet with a simple map pattern inside (parcels and a road). Just left of it: three tiny software windows stacked vertically, each with a title bar. From each tiny window, a thin red route with round caps goes right into the format sheet.
Far right, well away from the timeline: a small pale card with a little house pictogram and a location pin.
Keep the area below the timeline completely empty. Absolutely no numbers, no percentages, no labels, no letters anywhere.

elements.frise: the horizontal timeline line with its arrowhead (without the milestones)
elements.contrat: the document sheet with the round seal at the top left
elements.fondateurs: the small card with two human silhouettes
elements.jalon1993: the left milestone tick with its dot on the timeline
elements.cases: the small year cell ticks between the two milestones
elements.saif: the format sheet with the map pattern above the timeline
elements.fenetres: the three tiny stacked software windows left of the format sheet
elements.routes: the red routes from the tiny windows into the format sheet
elements.jalon1996: the right milestone tick with its dot on the timeline
elements.siege: the small card with the house and location pin on the far right
